_doc: Sigma Protocol repo-local cascade registry. Student-safe, self-contained, and resolved relative to this repository. INTENTIONAL 13-department layout (engineering, security, legal, marketing, content, finance, ops, sales, product, community, trading, design, qa): this is the full firm org so the routing covers every Sigma workflow surface and a paying client gets a complete bench. Leaner installs MAY collapse departments (e.g. fold finance into product, trading out entirely, content into marketing) but the validators expect exactly 13 here — keep the count at 13 and use config.department_aliases to remap, do not delete a department. Every department head + bench sub-agent resolves to a file under .claude/agents/<dept>/, and every skill ref resolves to .claude/skills/<slug>/SKILL.md; refs that only exist in the global ~/.claude pool are deliberately NOT used here (student-safe self-containment).
